originality.rationale: New claim is exact S_n×C2 rational character for common-edge pentagonal books, including reflection factor and Specht decomposition. Bayer–Jelić Milutinović–Vega nonequivariant reduction is recognized as prior coverage of the wedge count; their polygonal line classification is inapplicable for ≥3 pages sharing one edge. Targeted published literature and database searches found no dominating character theorem. Residual risk is unindexed equivalent results.

value.rationale: The high-symmetry graph family has a natural growing S_n×C2 action. The exact rational representation determines every automorphism trace for arbitrarily many pages, distinguishes sign/parity and identifies irreducible Specht constituents.
